Arey Confusedbhaiya! Aapne jo **`Octo-Lex/ChatGPT-Web2API`** aur **`AbdullahArean/Web2API`** ke details share kiye hain, unka ek clear comparison aur implementation guide niche diya hai taaki aap decide kar sako ki kaunsa setup aapke use case ke liye best rahega.

---

## ⚖️ Comparison: ChatGPT-Web2API vs. Web2API (Multi-Provider)

| Feature | `Octo-Lex/ChatGPT-Web2API` | `AbdullahArean/Web2API` |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Approach** | Drives a **real Chrome browser via CDP** (handles Turnstile/PoW automatically). | Uses **browser session cookies** directly via HTTP requests. |
| **Supported Providers** | ChatGPT only (Plus subscription). | **Perplexity, ChatGPT, & Gemini** unified. |
| **Authentication** | No tokens needed; logs into Chrome on first run. | Requires manual cookie extraction (`*.local.json` or `.env`). |
| **Agentic / MCP Support** | **Built-in MCP Server** (16 tools for Cursor/Claude Desktop). | FastAPI REST server with SSE streaming and `/docs`. |
| **Best For** | Seamless automated local agent workflows without cookie expiry headaches. | Multi-model REST API setup using session cookies. |

---

## 🚀 Quick Setup Guide

### Option 1: Using `ChatGPT-Web2API` (Chrome CDP Method)
Agar aapko bina kisi cookie-extraction ke seedha ChatGPT ko OpenAI-compatible endpoint ya MCP server ki tarah use karna hai:

```bash
# 1. Install package
pip install chatgpt-web2api

# 2. Start server (opens Chrome on first run for manual login if needed)
chatgpt-web2api
```

Python SDK / OpenAI Client integration:
```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:8080/v1", api_key="not-needed")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="auto",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is 8+7?"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

---

### Option 2: Using `AbdullahArean/Web2API` (Cookie-Based Multi-Provider)
Agar aapko Perplexity, ChatGPT aur Gemini teeno ko ek hi unified Python library ya REST API ke through chalana hai:

```bash
# 1. Clone & Install
git clone https://github.com/AbdullahArean/web2api.git
cd web2api
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install .

# 2. Auth Setup (Copy examples and fill your browser cookies)
cp auth/cookies.local.json.example auth/cookies.local.json
```

Python usage snippet:
```python
from web2api import chatgpt, gemini, perplexity
from web2api.auth import load_chatgpt_auth

# ChatGPT Client
gpt = chatgpt.Client(load_chatgpt_auth())
print(gpt.chat("Hello!", stream=False))
```
